issues.title: The migration set is no longer self-consistent — a from-scratch rebuild fails
issues.note: **The RLS *verifier* was taught to read _archive/. The migration *runner* never was. Evidence (measured 2026-08-02). - supabase/migrations/ root holds 529 .sql files; _archive/ holds 52 more in three product subdirectories. The Supabase runner applies the root directory and does not recurse, so those 52 are never applied to a fresh database. - All three subdirectory READMEs are marked RLS-ARCHIVE-DISPOSITION: applied-live** — i.e. these migrations *were* applied and their objects are live on production. They are archived for tidiness, not because they were no-ops. - 18 root-level migrations reference tables whose CREATE TABLE now exists only under _archive/: cash_invoices ×6, cash_debtors ×4, esg_answers ×6, cyber_assessments ×2. - Concrete failure: 20260615160000_platform_cpg_trust_page.sql:102 builds the CPG materialised view with FROM public.cash_invoices, and that table is created only in _archive/crowcash/20260502400001_crowcash_schema.sql. Cost. Production is unaffected — the tables are live and the objects exist. But no environment can be rebuilt from migrations, which breaks: a staging rebuild, a fresh local db reset, disaster recovery, and any new environment. This is not hypothetical for this platform: staging was rebuilt from scratch on 2026-07-18 after a disk-full incident. Had that happened today it would have failed part-way through, in a way whose cause is several steps removed from the error message. This is the release's own theme, applied to itself. R262-RLS-001 fixed the parity *gate* so archival could not blind it — correctly, and with a disposition marker so the archive's meaning is machine-checked. But the same file move also removed those migrations from the apply path, and nothing checked *that*. The gate was made honest; the underlying inconsistency was not noticed. Recommended fix: move the 52 applied-live migrations back into supabase/migrations/. They were applied to production; the apply path is where they belong. Archival bought tidines

The trial path at :514 sets trial_period_days: 14 on the same session, so a card IS collected to begin a trial. The public site published *"No card is taken"* on 2026-08-05 under A-174. The open question is which way to resolve it, and it is commercial, not technical: - Drop the card for trials (payment_method_collection: "if_required") → the site can say "no card" again, which is a materially stronger offer for a public-sector buyer wary of an unexpected charge; or - Keep collecting → the site stays silent on cards for the trial, as it is now.
